import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
  static class Reader {
    static BufferedReader reader;
    static Scanner scanner;

    static void init(InputStream input) {
      reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(input));
      scanner = new Scanner(reader);
    }

    static String next() {
      return scanner.next();
    }

    static int nextInt() {
      return scanner.nextInt();
    }

    static long nextLong() {
      return scanner.nextLong();
    }

    static double nextDouble() {
      return scanner.nextDouble();
    }

    static String nextLine() {
      return scanner.nextLine();
    }
  }

  static long[] ones = {0, 1, 11, 111, 1111, 11111, 111111, 1111111, 11111111, 111111111, 1111111111, 11111111111L, 111111111111L, 1111111111111L, 11111111111111L, 111111111111111L, 1111111111111111L};

  public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
    Reader.init(System.in);
    long n = Reader.nextLong();
    long res = decompose(n);
    System.out.println(res);
  }

  public static long decompose(long n) {
    if (n <= 6) {
      return n;
    }
    long numOfDigits = getNumOfDigits(n);
    long lower, upper;
    lower = ones[(int) numOfDigits];
    if (n < lower) {
      upper = lower;
      lower = ones[(int) (numOfDigits - 1)];
    } else if (n > lower) {
      upper = ones[(int) (numOfDigits + 1)];
    } else {
      return numOfDigits;
    }
    long resLower = decompose(n % lower) + (n / lower) * getNumOfDigits(lower);
    long resUpper = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    if (upper - n < n) {
      resUpper = decompose(upper - n) + getNumOfDigits(upper);
    }
    return Math.min(resLower, resUpper);
  }

  public static long getNumOfDigits(long n) {
    return (long) Math.floor(Math.log10(n)) + 1;
  }
}
